settings.repere: Titre H3 · Our tester was surprised at just how swe
settings.text: Our tester was surprised at just how sweet and smooth Nowadays tasted, contrasting it with traditional spirits.”

settings.repere: Titre H3 · Whether you're trying to drink less alco
settings.text: Whether you're trying to drink less alcohol or you just want to take your edibles in liquid form, Nowadays is the product to try… Although you might assume that the flavor would be overwhelmingly weed-y, that really wasn't the case; it has an enjoyable floral flavor that actually works really well in a variety of cocktail recipes.

settings.repere: Titre H3 · A new take on spirits, Nowadays is a can
settings.text: A new take on spirits, Nowadays is a cannabis-infused juice of sorts that looks like liquor but without the harshness of alcohol—this drink will likely cure a hangover instead of causing one.

settings.repere: Titre H3 · I rarely smoke weed because I have a sup
settings.text: I rarely smoke weed because I have a super low tolerance and often overdo it, leading to paranoid thoughts so overbearing, I can't be around people. But this option let me precisely measure consumption. It also cut out any coughing, smoke residue and accoutrement I'm often missing like a lighter, ashtray and proper ventilation. Consuming cannabis as easily as pouring a vodka soda? That's something I can get behind.”
